read backpressure yields to decoders and retained metadata cannot stall images
dependency continuations do not block workers and preparation overlaps
exclusive transfer refuses copied subscriptions and borrowed payloads
retained continuation inputs survive cancellation of the caller subscription
unique completed requests do not accumulate expired cache metadata
reader workers overlap independently of CPU preparation
finalizers run only on the owner thread and expired owners cancel publication
nonpositive polling budgets do not start cooperative work or finalizers
failures cancellation invalidation and shutdown leave usable handles
prepared image adoption separates shared pixels and transfers exclusive pixels
mip preparation preserves padded alpha weighted integer filtering
WebP decoder preserves exact RGBA including transparent RGB

16-bit RGBA rounds normalized channels to the exporter reference
Native PNG and JPEG loading and saving remain available
WebP artwork lookup preserves directories without PNG alternatives
